evidence.non_llm_baseline: p.14: "Each network was then edited by six scripted editors on the test concepts: the two ERT edit rules, three sparse refits of the head ... and a rescaling of 32 channels"; "No LLM is involved." (used to screen/select training methods, not head-to-head vs LLM editors)
evidence.finetune_comparison_note: p.13: scripted editors include "a single gradient step on the head" (tuning/screen only); ENN is gradient-based editable training of the network, a training method not a repair comparator
evidence.code_or_data_released_note: p.1: "We will release our LLM testing framework"; p.20: "Release. We will release the tasks ... together with the code" (promised only)
evidence.full_test_set: p.8: "For all training methods, accuracy on the full test sets still ends 3 to 4 points below the unedited network after the final edit."
